"Imagine a medieval kingdom where the ruler has the power to conquer neighboring lands through a unique form of diplomacy: a high-stakes chat game. The ruler can challenge other kingdoms to a chat battle, where the goal is to outwit and outmaneuver the opponent through clever wordplay and strategic thinking.

The twist is that the ruler has a special ability: the power to *steal* a set number of words from the opponent's vocabulary, rendering them unable to use those words in the chat battle. The ruler can use this power strategically to disrupt the opponent's plans and gain an advantage.

The ruler has a vocabulary of 1000 words and can steal up to 20 words from the opponent's vocabulary per turn. If the opponent has a vocabulary of 2000 words and uses all 2000 words in the chat battle, how many turns would it take for the ruler to steal 1000 words from the opponent, assuming the opponent does not add any new words to their vocabulary after the chat battle begins?"
